judge.rationale: Approximately one-half to three-quarters of the molecular explanation is shared—especially PTMA, PABPC1, CKS2, FTH1, multiple named ribosomal proteins, TUBB4B/TUBA1C, ALDOA, PKM, and MYC-linked proliferation—while A and B add extensive cell-cycle, histone, redox, proteostasis, metabolic, and lineage contributors that C and especially D omit, so the incomplete-coverage ceiling of 6 applies.
